release_notes: V14.44 build 247 is the compile-corrected 30-minute chunked trend-recovery build. The 12-hour Nightscout history is read in smaller 30-minute windows with controlled service pauses after successive requests, failed-window retry, real-point validation and protection against replacing a better existing RAM trend with a poorer refill. The 1-hour mini trend is rebuilt from the newest hour of the shared 12-hour buffer and uses small 30-minute requests only when additional recovery is required. The build also retains the deliberate local buzzer controls, two-button forced 12-hour and mini-trend backfill, full NVS factory reset, insulin and carbohydrate history, IOB and COB screens, read-only ketone history, WhatsApp alerts, alarm acknowledgement and OTA protections.
